title: Kinematics During Running

positions.as_written: Treat running as a repeated absorb and return cycle.
Assess running separately from walking when a patient's symptoms are activity specific.
Expect patellofemoral symptoms to appear in running before walking, on the loading argument rather than on a structural one.
Consider fatigue when symptoms appear late in an activity rather than at the start.
Treat return to running as a mechanical decision rather than a time based one.
